entries.desc: validate --json 当前失败被真实 CLI 子进程复现，错误定位到 hint decoration

evidence.command: Agent 1 read-only reproduction: validate --json stdout followed by direct JSON.parse before fix
evidence.note: Agent 1 reproduced the original pre-fix failure: validate --json returned JSON plus a human success hint, so direct JSON.parse(stdout) failed; the root cause was hint decoration after the validate handler returned JSON text.

entries.desc: 已有正常 --format=json 命令仍被纳入矩阵，避免误判全 CLI 都坏

evidence.command: Agent 1 JSON command matrix for validate, authority_status, host_runtime_probe, and parallel_status
evidence.note: Agent 1 documented the affected/unaffected matrix: validate --json was broken because validate is hint-decorated, while representative existing JSON commands remained parseable because they were not in the hint registry.

entries.desc: 禁止把修复方案定为 dashboard 侧抽取 JSON substring

evidence.command: Review Agent 1 recommendation plus commit 8a0c0705 implementation approach
evidence.note: The selected fix explicitly rejects dashboard-side substring extraction and places the guard in the shared CLI output pipeline; Agent 3 confirmed no extractFirstJsonObject/regex JSON substring parser was introduced.

entries.desc: validate --json stdout 可直接 JSON.parse 且没有 “→ 验证全绿”

evidence.command: KOALA_SESSION_ID=codex-b7fc2 node packages/main/dist/cli.js validate --story=B-7fc2 --json --forceTakeover | node -e JSON.parse(stdin)
evidence.note: Worktree dist validate --json stdout parsed directly as a single JSON document; no human success hint was appended to stdout in machine JSON mode.

entries.desc: text mode validate 仍保留 “→ 验证全绿” next-step hint

evidence.note: Text-mode validate still emitted the human success next-step hint containing 验证全绿; the text-mode UX was preserved while JSON mode was cleaned.

entries.desc: 失败/coverage missing 的 JSON mode 也不能把修复建议拼进 stdout

evidence.command: KOALA_SESSION_ID=codex-b7fc2 node packages/main/dist/cli.js validate --story=B-7fc2 --json --forceTakeover | node -e JSON.parse(stdin)
evidence.note: Even when validate returned allPass=false because verification evidence was missing, worktree JSON mode stdout remained direct-parseable; the failure guidance was not appended to stdout.

entries.desc: 新 smoke 直接 JSON.parse execFileSync stdout

evidence.note: The new smoke spawns real CLI child processes and feeds captured stdout directly into JSON.parse, covering validate --json without substring extraction.

entries.desc: 一个已经正常的 --format=json 命令继续 parseable，防止输出管线回归

evidence.note: The smoke also covers existing --format=json surfaces such as authority_status and host_list, proving known-good JSON commands remain direct-parseable through the shared output pipeline.

entries.desc: 测试断言 stdout 不含 next-step hint，避免未来误把 hint 加回 JSON mode

evidence.note: The smoke asserts JSON stdout contains no human hint markers and that trimmed validate --json output ends at the single JSON document boundary, preventing future trailing decoration regressions.

entries.desc: Claude Code 三个 agent 均产出可追踪结论，Lattice delivery-check 接收

evidence.command: Claude Code Agent 1 audit + Agent 2 implementation + Agent 3 independent review; Codex reran focused validation
evidence.note: All three Claude Code roles produced traceable conclusions: Agent 1 audit, Agent 2 implementation commit 8a0c0705, and Agent 3 pass review; Codex reran build, focused smoke, migration smoke, direct JSON.parse, and text hint checks.

entries.desc: 如果某 agent 发现 blocking issue，story 留在 DEV/REVIEW 修复而不是硬 DONE

evidence.command: Agent 3 independent review and lattice finding_list --storyId=B-7fc2
evidence.note: Agent 3 found no blockers or advisory regressions, and finding_list returned no findings; if blockers had been found, the story would have remained in DEV rather than being advanced.

entries.desc: DONE summary 必须明确 no limitations 或列出未覆盖 JSON 命令，不允许抽象说全绿

evidence.note: Delivery evidence states the scoped limitation explicitly: no known limitations for the JSON stdout contract, while resolver/dashboard schema completion remains outside B-7fc2 and belongs to the host-neutral observability milestones.
